SOURCE STORY:
Amy cooks breakfast for Will and Amber wearing a black tank top and denim jeans. A zombie breaks the kitchen door window. Amy rushes Will and Amber into the basement and locks the door. She retrieves a pistol and katana. The majority of the film is Amy killing, dismembering, and decapitating zombies as they attack her. Amy kills the last zombie, leaving the house soaked in blood, then lets Will and Amber out of the basement.

MAJORITY REPAIR RULES:
- When the source describes a plural/repeated process but does not enumerate enough ordinary instances to fill the required majority, allocate additional ordinary instances of that same process across beats rather than treating the unnumbered instances as new plot.
- A beat counts only when Amy materially performs the emphasized process itself. Merely showing a zombie attack, approach, danger, preparation, weapon retrieval, or prerequisite does NOT count.
- Bundle adjacent setup into a counted combat beat when source order permits.
- Use distinct threat entity names for distinct attackers.
- Preserve the explicit last/final zombie as the terminal sequence beat.
- If the terminal kill is immediately followed by releasing the children, combine both in Beat 8 when needed so Beats 4-8 can all materially belong to the combat sequence.
